replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: That's fair feedback, and I appreciate you pointing out the specific differences. Some location-specific footage from Annobón is very limited, so we did use illustrative material in parts of the documentary, but when the language, clothing, or surroundings clearly don't match the island, it can make the story feel inaccurate. We should have been more careful with those details. Thank you for watching closely and helping us improve how we represent places like Annobón in future videos. 🙏

comments.author: @WorldTravelDocumentary18
comments.text: I find it fascinating that people can build an entire life on an island so far from the rest of the world. But I wonder if living in Annobón feels like freedom or isolation. What would you choose?

comments.author: @ImpossibleTravelogue99
comments.text: Refreshing how this video admits that not everyone stays by choice—sometimes leaving is just too expensive. Travel channels love romanticizing isolation, glad someone showed the real cost of it.

replies.author: @LifewaysTravel
replies.text: Exactly. Isolation can look peaceful from the outside, but for some people it also means limited choices, higher costs, and fewer ways to leave when they want to. I’m glad that part of the story came through. Thanks for recognizing it and for watching with us. 🙏
